# tenarium_member (Resource)

A membership linking a user to a tenant with a role. Adding an unknown email invites a new user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Invites alice if she has no account yet.
resource "tenarium_member" "alice" {
  tenant_id = tenarium_tenant.acme.id
  email     = "alice@acme.example"
  name      = "Alice"
  role      = "admin"
}

resource "tenarium_member" "bot" {
  tenant_id = tenarium_tenant.acme.id
  user_id   = "0190f3a2-0000-7000-8000-000000000001"
  role      = tenarium_tenant_role.support.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) Built-in or custom tenant role, e.g. `owner`, `admin` or `member`.
- `tenant_id` (String) ID (or slug) of the tenant. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `email` (String) Email of the user to add or invite. Exactly one of `email` and `user_id` must be set. Changing it replaces the membership.
- `name` (String) Name used when the membership creates (invites) a new user. Not read back.
- `user_id` (String) ID of an existing user. Exactly one of `email` and `user_id` must be set. Changing it replaces the membership.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Member ID.
- `status` (String) `invited`, `active` or `suspended`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tenarium_member.alice <tenant_id>/<member_id>
```
